TEAM_MULTISIG().notice: Team multisig allowed to trigger admin methods.

pauseAuthContract().notice: FluidPauseAuth main contract. Set once by multisig, then permanently locked.

pauseSmartLending(uint256).notice: Pauses the smart lending contract on a DEX pool. Returns event data.

pauseSwapAndArbitrage(uint256).notice: Pauses swap and arbitrage on a DEX pool. Returns event data.

pauseUser(uint256,address,bool,bool).notice: Pauses a specific user on a DEX pool. Returns the resolved dex address.

pauseVault(uint256,bool,bool).notice: Pauses a vault at the DEX layer. Returns event data.

setPauseAuthContract(address).notice: Sets the FluidPauseAuth main contract address. Can only be called once (permanently locked after).

unpauseSmartLending(uint256).notice: Unpauses the smart lending contract on a DEX pool. Returns event data.

unpauseSwapAndArbitrage(uint256).notice: Unpauses swap and arbitrage on a DEX pool. Returns event data.

unpauseUser(uint256,address,bool,bool).notice: Unpauses a specific user on a DEX pool. Returns the resolved dex address.

unpauseVault(uint256,bool,bool).notice: Unpauses a vault at the DEX layer. Returns event data.

userdoc.notice: Executes pause/unpause operations at the DEX layer. Callable only by the main FluidPauseAuth contract.          Does NOT emit operational events — the main contract handles all event emission based on return values.
